sheet_functionals.projective_frame: the four dual normals are a 4-arc in PG(2,3): every triple has rank 3

theorem: The 144 mixed Leech Lagrangians carry a canonical C3^3 sheet monodromy over the 48 Hesse lines. Exactly four kernel hyperplanes occur, each on 12 lines; their dual points form a projective frame, while the four elementary Lagrangians carry the matching A4 action.
claim_boundary: Exact finite linked-module action; A4->S4 requires similitudes.
